newsitem.title: USA: Chile purchases Oriente crude for mid-January.
newsitem.headline: Chile purchases Oriente crude for mid-January.

text.p: Chile's state oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) bought 400,000 barrels of Ecuadoran Oriente crude for January 14-17, amid other regional spot activity, trade sources said Thursday.
Tripetrol sold the cargo to ENAP for a discount of $3.75-4.00 to February West Texas Intermediate a barrel on an fob basis, the sources said.
Oriente was sold to ENAP in November for Jan WTI minus $4.25 a barrel.
ENAP usually also buys at least one cargo of West African crude such as Nigerian Escravos in its regular purchase tenders for 960,000 barrels, but offers were scarce in a tight market, traders said.
ENAP might issue another purchase tender next week for 960,000 barrels to compensate for the paucity of attractive offers, an ENAP official said.
Elsewhere, Shell is offering a cargo of Colombian Cano Limon crude for mid-January, traders said.
The company is asking Feb WTI minus $1.35 a barrel fob, trade sources said.
Separately, France's Total is offering a cargo of Colombian Cusiana for January 7-11, asking around Feb WTI plus 50 cents, traders said.
Colombia state oil company Ecopetrol is also offering a South Blend cargo for around January 20-22, trade sources said.
Meanwhile, bids are due today for 300,000 barrels of reconstituted crude on offer by Bolivian state oil company Yacimientos Petroliferos Fiscales Bolivianos (YPFB).
